name: 3D Character Selector - Mobile Touch (Gen 1 + Gen 2)
description: Mobile-friendly 3D character selector for Red/Blue/Yellow AND Gold. Adds the same skinned characters to overworld, Dramatic/Dramaless Shape battles, and VR, plus Android double-tap-to-3RD camera access and two-finger voxel-world pinch zoom. Includes static OceanGate Titan, donor-rig cloning, loose OBJ/FBX/DAE imports, accessories, touch controls, collision-safe eight-way movement, and true travel-direction 3D facing.
